title: Section cochain identifications respect the Hom differential
statement: For a ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], commutative ring sheaf R, object U and arbitrary module-sheaf cochain complexes L,I [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], let S be sections at U of their sheaf Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex], res restriction to U and π its chosen projections. Suppose additive equivalences e_n from S.X n to external degree-n cochains are given, and each component at p,q with p+n=q and localized W equals the evaluated projection π(L,I,n,p,q) applied to the section. Then for all integers i,j with i+1=j and all x in S.X i, e_j(S.d i j x)=δ i j(e_i x), where δ is Mathlib external Hom differential. No cycles or homology conclusion is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A8X, Section 21.34, construction and differential of Hom complexes; Tag 0A8Y, Equation 21.34.0.1

proof.text: For p+j=q, use the differential projection identity of homComplex_exists with q′=p+i and p′=p+1. Evaluate at U and at W, preserving subtraction and integer multiplication. Internal Hom pre- and postcomposition become composition with the restricted complex differentials.

Substitute the hypothesized component formulas for e_i and e_j. The external differential formula δ_v uses j.negOnePow on the second summand; from j=i+1 derive j.negOnePow=-i.negOnePow. Thus both component maps agree. Extensionality of module-sheaf morphisms and cochains concludes. At i=0 this is d_I f-f d_L; at i=-1 it is d_I f+f d_L, and zero complexes give zero on both sides.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the degreewise product and differential arguments preceding Equation 21.34.0.1

theorem homComplex_sections_cochains_comm
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let E := (SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    letI := module_overFunctor_preservesZero R₀ U
    let res := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let S := E.obj (homComplex (R := R) L I)
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    ∀ (e : ∀ n : ℤ, S.X n ≃+
        CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain (res.obj L) (res.obj I) n),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : S.X n) (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
        ((e n x).v p q hpq).val.app W =
          (((π L I n p q hpq).val.app (op U)) x).app W) →
      ∀ (i j : ℤ), i + 1 = j → ∀ x : S.X i,
        e j (S.d i j x) = CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ i j (e i x)
